title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to zero degrees for all axes and the translation vector to [0.0, 0.0, 0.75] meters. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the specified plane. Begin by creating the first face with the first loop. Draw the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0536, 0.0) meters. Continue by drawing the second line from (0.0536, 0.0) to (0.0536, 0.0536) meters. Then, draw the third line from (0.0536, 0.0536) to (0.0, 0.0536) meters, and complete the loop by drawing the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0536) back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0536. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.75] meters. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.75 meters in the direction opposite to the normal to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism are 0.0536 meters in length, 0.0536 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0536, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0536, 0.0536)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0536)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular prism
extruded_body = sketch.extrude(-0.75)  # Extrude opposite to the normal direction

# Translate the extruded body to the specified position
r = extruded_body.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.75))

# The final model is represented as 'r'

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the top face
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0536, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0536, 0.0536) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0536) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
r = r.extrude(0.75)
